name: Baseball Studs Simulator ⚾
desc:
Welcome to Baseball Studs Simulator! ⚾🔥

Get ready to step up to the plate and become the ultimate baseball champion! Swing your bat, hit the ball as far as possible, and prove you're the strongest player in the game!

🌟 New Updates Every Week! 🌟

🔹 How To Play:
🏋️‍♂️ Train to increase your power and improve your swing!
💥 Smash the ball as hard as you can to reach new distances!
🏆 Collect Wins to unlock better bats and exclusive pets!
🌍 Climb the Top 10 Leaderboards!


👀 Use code "RELEASE" for free wins and strength!
